image_description: A small, dark-colored mud turtle positioned on a rough, light grey concrete surface. The turtle has a high-domed, oval carapace that appears dark brown to black with a matte texture showing some wear. The head is extended forward, displaying a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. The limbs are partially visible, appearing short and stout with dark, scaly skin. The plastron and tail are not clearly visible due to the side-top viewing angle and the turtle's posture.
